lessons.title: Welcome to C++
lessons.description: Start with the C++ entry point, output, and your first compile-ready program.

theorySlides.title: Welcome to C++ Overview
theorySlides.content: C++ programs begin in int main(). You often use #include <iostream> and cout to print output. This structure is the base for all future lessons.

theorySlides.title: C++ Example
theorySlides.content: Keep programs small and readable. Write one statement, run it, then improve step by step.
